title: BRAKES - CONTENTS
summary: Contents of UPC 5, Brakes (all models): brake pedal housing and reinforcement, brake pedal and master cylinder, front and rear brake calipers, front and rear brake lines, parking brake and parking brake cables. Also gives the brake system leak test: 1600 PSI for 10 to 25 seconds without tripping the pressure differential switch.
notes: NOTE: Brake system to be inspected for leaks at 1600 PSI for minimum of 10 seconds, maximum of 25 seconds. Pressure differential switch must not activate during this test.
notes_internal: Index page: no parts. Table copied from the two-column contents list; two-line titles joined with a space.
